assets.title: Original Medium Bench Drill Press
assets.description: Original static workshop bench drill press with a planar cast base, rear steel column, bored adjustable-height table, separate support arm and sleeves, quill and chuck, fixed fluted bit, enclosed belt cover, rear motor, and three-spoke feed handle. Limited teal, steel and charcoal palette. Independent closed editable parts in one fixed pose. No anchoring system has been supplied or certified. No motion, drilling performance, load capacity, workholding suitability, or safety certification is claimed.
